about.headline: Building the web,
paragraphs: I'm Anthony Kruger, a software engineer and the founder of EZdev Solutions, which I run alongside my full-time engineering role.

My career began in retail, where I led a team and exceeded sales targets as a Branch Manager. Along the way I discovered a passion for web development, which led me to a BSc in Information Technology, completed in 2021.
Through EZdev I own and run Votera and Chilli Collective, and take on a small number of client projects.
